name: flyte-skills
description: Claude Code skills for working with Flyte.

plugins.name: flyte-deploy-aws
plugins.description: Deploy a Flyte v2 (flyte-binary) cluster on AWS from scratch — EKS + S3 + RDS PostgreSQL + AWS Load Balancer Controller + helm, with optional TLS and Okta SSO.

plugins.name: flyte-deploy-kind
plugins.description: Deploy a Flyte v2 (flyte-binary) cluster on a local kind cluster, backed by a hosted PostgreSQL (Supabase/external) and S3-compatible object store (AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2), with optional OIDC auth via Traefik + oauth2-proxy and an in-cluster Dex IdP for testing.
